fix(editor): keep raster photographs out of runtime document JSON (#197)

Raster data URLs stall drag and rebuild when inlined into element JSON
and the committed SVG. Import them through the asset store so the canvas
only holds a short asset URI, a remote URL, or a small SVG data URL.
